description: A personal reading of what someone's birth date (and birth time, if known) says about them: who they are, how they love, where their energy runs high or low, and what the current chapter of their life is about. Use when someone asks what their birthday or birth time says about them, wants a birth chart or life reading, feels stuck, or asks about their path, love life or career. Answer in plain everyday words in the user's language; no astrology knowledge is needed.

gender.description: Optional; needed to say which ten-year chapter of life they are in
